spec.name: MissingSecurityHeadersValidator
spec.description: Checks for missing security headers on HTTP endpoints.

spec.name: InjectionValidator
spec.description: Checks for reflected XSS and basic SQL error-based injection signals.

spec.name: InsecureDesignValidator
spec.description: Checks for workflow and state-transition bypass behavior.

spec.name: BrokenAccessControlValidator
spec.description: Checks unauthenticated access to sensitive endpoints and direct object access controls.

spec.name: CryptoValidator
spec.description: Checks for weak TLS versions and sensitive data transmitted over plaintext HTTP.

spec.name: AuthValidator
spec.description: Checks login endpoints for rate limiting and insecure remember-me cookie flags.

spec.name: OutdatedComponentsValidator
spec.description: Checks for known CVE indicators and outdated component/version disclosures.

spec.name: SSRFValidator
spec.description: Attempts loopback fetches through suspected URL parameters to validate SSRF behavior.

spec.name: IDORValidator
spec.description: Tests for object-level authorization bypass by comparing baseline and tampered IDs.

spec.title: Unauthenticated Redis Access
spec.description: Redis exposed on 6379 and accepting unauthenticated connections.

spec.title: Missing Security Headers
spec.description: HTTP response missing baseline defensive headers.
